[message_id=688052 author=blckvia first=True]
I trained a model but the submission.zip file is too large to download and then upload to Kaggle. I also tried Save & Run All (Commit), but it runs on a P100 GPU which doesn't have enough memory, so it fails as well. How can I submit my output file?

[message_id=3435623 author=CPMP first=False]
you must use the RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell GPU.

[message_id=3435634 author=blckvia first=False]
When I trained, I used a Blackwell GPU, but when I tried to commit and submit, I selected "Run with GPU for all/this sessions" and Kaggle used a P100 instead. I also have submission.zip in my working directory in Kaggle but it's 3GB and I can't download it through the browser. Is there another way to submit this file?
pic

[message_id=3435681 author=CPMP first=False]
sleect the blackwell when you submit.

[message_id=3435755 author=Vedrin Jeliazkov first=False]
When I trained, I used a Blackwell GPU, but when I tried to commit and submit, I selected "Run with GPU for all/this sessions" and Kaggle used a P100 instead. I also have submission.zip in my working directory in Kaggle but it's 3GB and I can't download it through the browser. Is there another way to submit this file?
With persistence enabled (files only) you could start a new CPU-only session (without any accelerator and with Internet enabled) and submit to the competition by running a command like:
!kaggle competitions submit -c nvidia-nemotron-model-reasoning-challenge -f submission.zip -m "My first submission" 
In such a way you would avoid consuming some of your GPU quota in the submission process.

[message_id=3436000 author=blckvia first=False]
Thank you a lot

[message_id=3436001 author=blckvia first=False]
I finally found where I can choose GPU for "Save & Run All"
